name: Daylight
description: Everyone is where they are supposed to be, and so is the light.

name: Dusk
description: The shift change, and the hour nobody looks closely.

name: Night
description: Skeleton staff, hard shadows, and nowhere to explain yourself.

name: Dawn
description: The tired end of the graveyard shift.

name: Clear
description: Nothing in the weather helps or hinders.

name: Rain
description: Steady rain masks a footstep and ruins a foothold.

name: Fog
description: Excellent cover, and you cannot see the camera either.

name: Storm
description: Thunder covers noise; the roof is trying to kill you.

name: Crowded
description: A room full of people is the best door in the building.

name: Well Lit
description: Every corner accounted for, and every lock easy to read.

name: Noisy
description: Machinery, music, or traffic — nobody hears anything.

name: High Security
description: Layered, funded, and drilled. Everything is harder here.

name: Wired
description: Everything runs through a panel, and panels have opinions.

name: Old Money
description: Brass locks, thick doors, and staff who know every face.

name: Understaffed
description: Two guards covering six floors, and both of them know it.

name: Private Security
description: Paid well, drilled often, and unimpressed by paperwork.
